categories.name: Arithmetic & Expression Evaluation
categories.desc: Direct computation of a numeric expression, fractions, order of operations, nested fractions, simplifying a given numerical expression.

categories.name: Defined Operations & Notation
categories.desc: A new operation or symbol is defined (e.g. a⋆b = ...) and must be evaluated or solved.

categories.name: Linear Equations & Word Problems
categories.desc: Set up and solve one linear equation from a story: ages, coins, purchases, weights, 'how many' with one unknown.

categories.name: Systems of Equations
categories.desc: Two or more unknowns related by several equations; solve the system or find a combination of the variables.

categories.name: Rates: Distance, Speed & Time
categories.desc: Travel, meeting, chasing, average speed, trains, walking/biking, escalators, clocks of travel.

categories.name: Work & Combined Rates
categories.desc: Jobs done together, pipes filling tanks, painting, production rates.

categories.name: Percents, Ratios & Proportions
categories.desc: Percent increase/decrease, discounts, ratios between quantities, mixtures, proportional reasoning, unit conversions.

categories.name: Mean, Median, Mode & Range
categories.desc: Averages, medians, modes, ranges of data sets; changes to averages when values added/removed.

categories.name: Exponents & Radicals
categories.desc: Laws of exponents, simplifying radicals, nested radicals, comparing powers, rationalizing.

categories.name: Logarithms
categories.desc: Problems with log notation or requiring logarithm properties.

categories.name: Algebraic Manipulation & Identities
categories.desc: Factoring, difference of squares, symmetric expressions (x+1/x), clever expansions, simplifying algebraic expressions. Also rational expressions and rational equations.

categories.name: Quadratics & Vieta's Formulas
categories.desc: Quadratic equations, roots, discriminant, sum/product of roots, completing the square, parabola vertex.

categories.name: Polynomials (higher degree)
categories.desc: Cubic or higher polynomials, remainder/factor theorem, polynomial roots and coefficients, polynomial identities.

categories.name: Functions & Composition
categories.desc: Function notation, composition, inverse, functional equations, function iteration, piecewise functions.

categories.name: Linear Graphs, Slopes & Intercepts
categories.desc: Lines in the coordinate plane as algebra: slope, intercepts, intersection of lines, line equations (no area focus).

categories.name: Inequalities & Optimization
categories.desc: Solving inequalities, max/min of an expression, AM-GM, bounding, which value is largest.

categories.name: Absolute Value
categories.desc: Equations or inequalities involving absolute values.

categories.name: Floor, Ceiling & Rounding
categories.desc: Greatest integer function, ceiling, rounding behaviour.

categories.name: Arithmetic Sequences & Series
categories.desc: Sequences with constant difference, sums of arithmetic series, sums 1+2+...+n.

categories.name: Geometric Sequences & Series
categories.desc: Sequences with constant ratio, finite/infinite geometric sums.

categories.name: Recursive Sequences & Patterns
categories.desc: Sequences defined recursively, periodic sequences, find the 2023rd term, growing patterns, telescoping sums.

categories.name: Complex Numbers
categories.desc: Imaginary unit i, complex arithmetic or roots of unity.

categories.name: Trigonometry
categories.desc: Sine/cosine/tangent identities or equations (outside a pure geometry figure).

categories.name: Divisibility & Divisibility Rules
categories.desc: Whether one number divides another, divisibility rules (3, 9, 11), multiples counting, 'how many integers divisible by'.

categories.name: Divisors: Counting & Sums
categories.desc: Number of divisors, sum of divisors, perfect numbers, factor pairs.

categories.name: Primes & Prime Factorization
categories.desc: Primality, prime factorizations, largest prime factor, products of primes.

categories.name: GCD & LCM
categories.desc: Greatest common divisor, least common multiple, simultaneous periodic events.

categories.name: Remainders & Modular Arithmetic
categories.desc: Remainders on division, congruences, Chinese remainder style problems.

categories.name: Units Digit & Last Digits
categories.desc: Last digit(s) of large powers or products, cyclic last-digit patterns.

categories.name: Digits & Digit Sums
categories.desc: Properties of decimal digits: digit sums, palindromes, reversing digits, numbers with digit constraints, decimal expansions.

categories.name: Number Bases
categories.desc: Numbers written in bases other than 10.

categories.name: Integer Equations (Diophantine)
categories.desc: Find integer/positive-integer solutions to an equation, SFFT (Simon's favourite factoring), coin/postage combinations.

categories.name: Factorials & Trailing Zeros
categories.desc: Factorials, trailing zeros, powers of a prime dividing n!.

categories.name: Perfect Squares & Cubes
categories.desc: Perfect squares/cubes/powers, making an expression a perfect square.

categories.name: Fractions, Decimals & Rationals
categories.desc: Repeating decimals, fractions in lowest terms, rational vs irrational, terminating decimals.

categories.name: Parity & Integer Properties
categories.desc: Odd/even arguments, integer constraints, consecutive integers.

categories.name: Basic Counting & Casework
categories.desc: Count objects by listing or careful casework, multiplication principle, complementary counting.

categories.name: Arrangements & Permutations
categories.desc: Ordering people/letters/objects in a line or circle, seating with restrictions, permutations of a word.

categories.name: Combinations & Selections
categories.desc: Choosing subsets, committees, handshakes, binomial coefficients, subsets with properties.

categories.name: Distributions & Stars and Bars
categories.desc: Distributing identical/distinct objects into groups, solutions to x1+...+xk = n.

categories.name: Inclusion-Exclusion & Venn Diagrams
categories.desc: Overlapping sets, Venn diagrams, counting with overlaps.

categories.name: Paths, Grids & Lattice Counting
categories.desc: Lattice paths, routes in a grid/graph, counting rectangles/squares in grids, colorings of grids.

categories.name: Recursive Counting & States
categories.desc: Counting via recursion (no two consecutive, tilings, stairs), states/transitions.

categories.name: Probability: Discrete Outcomes
categories.desc: Probability with equally likely outcomes: drawing balls/cards, choosing numbers, random selections.

categories.name: Probability: Dice, Coins & Spinners
categories.desc: Probability problems built on dice rolls, coin flips, spinners.

categories.name: Geometric Probability
categories.desc: Probability measured by length/area/volume, random points in a region, random real numbers.

categories.name: Expected Value
categories.desc: Expected value, expected number of steps/outcomes.

categories.name: Conditional & Multi-stage Probability
categories.desc: Conditional probability, sequential processes, games of chance with stages, random walks/frogs/states with probability.

categories.name: Pigeonhole & Extremal Counting
categories.desc: Minimum needed to guarantee something, pigeonhole principle, worst case.

categories.name: Counting with Symmetry
categories.desc: Count colorings/labelings/arrangements where rotations or reflections are considered the same (necklaces, cube labelings, circular arrangements up to symmetry).

categories.name: Graphs & Networks
categories.desc: Friendship/acquaintance networks, vertices and edges, tournaments as graphs, connecting points with segments, routes in networks of roads.

categories.name: Angle Chasing
categories.desc: Find angle measures using parallel lines, triangle angle sums, isosceles triangles, polygons' angle sums, clock angles.

categories.name: Triangle Areas & Area Ratios
categories.desc: Areas of triangles, ratios of areas, Heron's formula, triangles sharing heights.

categories.name: Right Triangles & Pythagorean Theorem
categories.desc: Right triangles, Pythagorean triples, 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 triangles, distances via Pythagoras.

categories.name: Similar Triangles
categories.desc: Problems solved by similar triangles, proportional segments, angle bisector theorem, parallel lines cutting triangles.

categories.name: Triangle Centers, Inradius & Circumradius
categories.desc: Incircle/circumcircle radii, centroid, orthocenter, medians, special points of triangles.

categories.name: Triangle Inequality & Side Lengths
categories.desc: Possible side lengths, integer-sided triangles, triangle existence, perimeter constraints.

categories.name: Quadrilaterals (Rectangles, Trapezoids, Parallelograms)
categories.desc: Lengths and areas in squares, rectangles, trapezoids, rhombi, kites, parallelograms.

categories.name: Regular Polygons & Polygons
categories.desc: Regular hexagons/octagons/pentagons, polygon interior angles and areas, star polygons.

categories.name: Circles: Area, Circumference & Arcs
categories.desc: Areas of circles/sectors/segments, arc lengths, circumference, rolling circles.

categories.name: Circles: Chords, Tangents & Inscribed Angles
categories.desc: Tangent lines, chords, inscribed angles, power of a point, tangent circles, cyclic quadrilaterals.

categories.name: Shaded & Composite Regions
categories.desc: Area of shaded/overlapping regions built from several shapes (circles+squares etc.).

categories.name: Coordinate Geometry
categories.desc: Geometry in coordinates: distances, areas of figures given by coordinates, shoelace, lattice points in regions, circles in coordinates.

categories.name: Graphs of Equations & Regions
categories.desc: Area/shape of region defined by equations or inequalities (|x|+|y|≤k, intersecting curves), parabolas and circles graphed.

categories.name: Reflections, Rotations & Folding
categories.desc: Reflections, rotations, translations, paper folding, symmetry.

categories.name: 3D: Volume & Surface Area
categories.desc: Volumes and surface areas of prisms, cylinders, cones, spheres, pyramids.

categories.name: 3D: Cubes, Nets & Spatial Reasoning
categories.desc: Cubes built from unit cubes, painted cubes, nets, views, cross sections, space diagonals, tetrahedra/polyhedra structure.

categories.name: 3D: Spheres & Distances in Space
categories.desc: Spheres (tangent, stacked, inscribed), distances between points in 3D, 3D coordinates, curves on solids.

categories.name: Trigonometry in Geometry
categories.desc: Law of cosines/sines, trig ratios inside a figure.

categories.name: Perimeter & Lengths of Segments
categories.desc: Perimeters, lengths of paths/segments in figures, tiling and dissection lengths (not mainly triangle/circle methods).

categories.name: Logic Puzzles & Truth-tellers
categories.desc: Liars/truth-tellers, deduction puzzles, who-did-what, statements that must be true.

categories.name: Games & Strategy
categories.desc: Two-player games, winning strategies, process/algorithm simulation with choices.

categories.name: Calendars, Clocks & Time
categories.desc: Days of the week, dates, clock readings, time zones, elapsed time.

categories.name: Tables, Charts & Data Reading
categories.desc: Read information from a graph, bar chart, pie chart, or table.

categories.name: Everyday Arithmetic & Money
categories.desc: Short real-life arithmetic: prices, tips, change, unit pricing, simple estimation (usually early problems).

categories.name: Processes, Operations & Invariants
categories.desc: Repeated operations, simulations, invariants, tournament/sports scheduling, card shuffles, number games on a board.

categories.name: Magic Squares & Number Placement
categories.desc: Filling grids/figures with numbers so sums match, cryptarithms, digit placement puzzles.
